title: AYA Universe
description:
Don't miss Dubai's viral immersive sensation! AYA is an out-of-this-world experience that transports guests to a beautiful and mysterious star in a distant galaxy. Wander through 12 gorgeous worlds that reveal infinite star fields, reverse waterfalls, glittering gardens, and rare cosmic spectacles.

Explore, connect, and create with friends and family on an unforgettable journey and discover AYA's secrets for yourself!
highlights: Each of AYA’s 12 worlds explores a different cosmic spectacle of impossible beauty.
Spark life across the universe in the Source.
Dance with light across infinite dimensions in Harmonia.
Float and travel through the hearts of stars in Drift.
Witness a cosmic storm in a glittering garden in Flora.
quickFacts: 2 hour average visit. Stay as long as you want!

title: Dubai Miracle Garden
description: Visit the world's largest natural flower garden. A world of floral wonder awaits at Dubai Miracle Garden.

title: Ferrari World Ticket
description: Experience the thrill of the world's first Ferrari-branded theme park. Home to the fastest roller coaster in the world.
highlights: Formula Rossa - the fastest roller coaster

title: Sharjah Aquarium
description: Discover the hidden world of the deep sea with its amazing creatures. Enjoy a close look at the local fishes and learn about Sharjah's historic coasts and ports.
